root: ^Amelia: Well now, look what the road dragged in! You look half-starved. Tonight’s special is rabbit stew with garden vegetables, bread fresh from the oven,
^ and mead—hot or cold, depending on how bold you’re feeling.

c-1: ^Amelia: You mean how I ended up a tavern owner? I married one. Then one morning he decided he was tired of the married life, claimed there were better catches in the sea, and off he went. Never saw him again.
^Amelia: I won’t pretend I’m easy to live with—hot-headed, stubborn, sharper than most men care for. Still, I kept the place for myself.
^ Turns out I’m better at keeping the fire lit, the ale flowing, and hot-blooded fools from splitting each other’s skulls before dessert.
^Amelia: Adventure? I could’ve chased it. But why wander the wilds when the whole world eventually stumbles through my door?

s0: ^Amelia: Word is, a blue-haired prince’s been locked away in a tower up in Mountainpass. Trouble always brews in that cursed pass.
s1: ^Amelia: The King’s ordered an audit of the army. Every soldier is walking on eggshells... it's a bad month for the tavern, as you might guess.
s2: ^Amelia: Orcs near town? Hells, let them come—so long as they’ve got gold. Muddy boots in my hall, though… that’ll cost extra.
